title: price.updated
description: SPECULATIVE — ADD FIRST (most matching rows assume prices flow; today they only move inside bid windows). A published price changed. Matches other firms' open POs, standing orders, and purchase history: the cafe-sees-$0.42/oz-and-requotes flow.

schema_version.description: Bumped on breaking shape change. Consumers branch on it.

openly_operated.description: Set at emit time from the gerp's settings. The publication rule's filter — a private gerp's events never leave the operator plane.

customer_id.description: Emitting tenant (gerp_id). Redundant with the envelope account id but saves consumers a join.

prior_price.description: Previous price; lets consumers compute the delta without state.

location.description: Location ordinal (the 1 in LOCATION#1#...). Present on placeful objects so cross-firm matches can be geo/loc-scoped; '1' = the emitter's main location.
